niche: a GP federation placing its two 2027-28 UTI pathway pharmacists in the primary care networks where moving off-guideline first courses for uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection in women to nitrofurantoin stops the most first courses meeting an organism resistant to the drug, each course priced from the laboratory's urine culture susceptibilities
analyst_test: With every culture, code and course read correctly and the specification applied, the strong analyst prices each off-guideline drug at its resistance in the federation's community urine cultures from women aged 16 to 64, first isolate per woman a year as a cumulative antibiogram is built, and since a culture follows most failed courses that rate carries nitrofurantoin near 12 per cent and makes every course moved to it from pivmecillinam, cefalexin or co-amoxiclav look worthless, so it places the pharmacists in the two trimethoprim-heavy networks (Kesterby and Ashwell Vale).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each drug's chance of meeting an organism the laboratory reports resistant among the infections a first course treats, the coverage term of an empiric antibiotic's benefit-risk, and it turns on how urine cultures come to be sent in primary care (after a failed course far more often than at a first consultation, so a drug's own failures send the laboratory its resistant organisms), which no swap into another field's nouns carries over.

driver: A choice's failure share among the cases a first choice treats is read from records made mostly after a first choice has failed, so the current choices' own failures fill the record with the cases they fail on and shrink every alternative's apparent gain; only the records made before any choice was given estimate the share, and read there the comparison between alternatives reverses.
driver_concrete: Each off-guideline drug's chance of meeting a resistant organism is read on the urine cultures sent at a first consultation (no UTI antibiotic in the episode before the specimen), not on every community culture, because GPs culture after a failed course far more than at presentation and nitrofurantoin's and trimethoprim's failed courses fill the laboratory's record with organisms resistant to them, so nitrofurantoin reads near 12 per cent instead of 6 and the pivmecillinam courses that moving to it would fix look worthless.
stump: The default path prices each off-guideline first course at its antibacterial's resistance in the federation's 2024 to 2026 community urine antibiogram for women aged 16 to 64, first isolate per woman and organism a year, where nitrofurantoin reads 19.0 per cent because a culture follows nearly every failed course and nitrofurantoin's failures send the laboratory the organisms resistant to it, so moving pivmecillinam and fosfomycin courses to nitrofurantoin looks worthless and the pharmacists go to Kesterby and Ashwell Vale for their trimethoprim; read on the cultures sent at a first course's own consultation, nitrofurantoin is 5.4 per cent against pivmecillinam's 13.1 and fosfomycin's 9.9, and Morrow Cross and Tamsey stop the most mismatched first courses.

differentiation.task308: task308 v3 conditions an added unit's availability on the hours the decision prices, read from sister units out together on one fuel service; here nothing is conditioned on the period priced: the record itself is made by the outcome (a culture is sent because a course failed), so the conditioning is on how each record came to exist, and the fix is reading the records made before any course, not replaying hours
differentiation.task269: task269 v5 samples audit occasions on a common cause of the outcome (shift staffing) and models compliance on that cause before carrying it over every shift; here the outcome itself sends the record (a resistant organism fails the course and the failure is cultured), so no covariate repairs it and only the records made before any course could act estimate the rate

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:a program median rebuilt from its cells' released percentiles, and a day's work status dated from a job's pay inside its first or last quarter
lineage.driver: Two quantities a decision counts are recorded at a coarser grain than the decision reads: a group's half point is published only for its parts as each part's percentiles, so it is the half point of the parts' rebuilt distributions pooled, not a weighted mean of the parts' half points; and a unit's state on one day is recorded only as each source's amount for the whole period holding that day, so a source's start or end inside the period is dated from its amount there against its amount in a full period.
